About TCS 
 Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is a global leader in IT services, digital, and business solutions that partners with its clients to simplify, strengthen, and transform their businesses. We ensure the highest levels of certainty and satisfaction through a deep-set commitment to our clients, comprehensive industry expertise, and a global network of innovation and delivery centers.
 TCS operates globally, with a diverse team of highly trained consultants working across 53 countries.
 TCS has maintained a business presence in Romania since 2019. As its business continues to grow, TCS Romania has expanded its client portfolio, offering a range of services including Engineering/IT, Human Resources Outsourcing (HRO), and Banking Support.
 About the Role: 
 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer specializing in Google BigQuery to design and deliver high-performance data solutions supporting complex reporting functions, as well as migrating on-premises platforms to modern cloud-based ecosystems.
 You will work with large-scale financial datasets, delivering secure, compliant, and low-latency data solutions that enable analytics and decision-making across the organization.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data warehouse solutions in BigQuery, including dataset architecture, schema design, and dimensional data modeling using star and snowflake schemas.
Design and implement cloud-native data warehouse solutions to support the migration from on-premises infrastructure.
Optimize BigQuery performance through partitioning, clustering, query tuning, and workload management.
Design, build, and maintain data processing pipelines and workflows to ingest and transform data from multiple sources into BigQuery.
Implement and maintain data quality checks, validation frameworks, and reconciliation processes to ensure data accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with product owners and analysts to ensure solutions align with business requirements.
 What We're Looking For: 
Demonstrated experience in data engineering, including designing and delivering scalable data solutions.
Strong SQL proficiency, preferably with hands-on experience using Google BigQuery on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience orchestrating data workflows using Google Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow), including developing directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), scheduling, monitoring, and managing workflow dependencies.
Hands-on experience designing and building batch and streaming data processing pipelines using Google Cloud Dataflow.
Good understanding of data warehousing concepts, data flows, and data feeds.
Experience using Bitbucket for Git-based version control, code collaboration, and repository management.
Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.
 Bonus Skills 
Hands-on experience with Python and/or PySpark for scalable, distributed data processing.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Chef.
Knowledge of shell scripting.
Experience in financial services or regulated environments.
 Why Join Us? 
 At Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), we are committed to creating an environment where employees can grow, innovate, and thrive.
 As a global leader in consulting and technology services, TCS offers stability, continuous learning opportunities, and a forward-looking culture shaped by collaboration and excellence.
 What You Can Expect
 Multicultural Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a diverse, international working environment.
 Growth & Ownership: Opportunities to take ownership of responsibilities, work independently, and develop professionally.
 Competitive Package: A competitive compensation and benefits package, along with opportunities for long-term career development.
 Agile & Supportive Workplace: A collaborative and supportive environment that empowers employees to perform at their best.
